names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Αγαπητός Επίσκοπος Ωξέρρης», with the rank word and the see left off.

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Αγαπητός κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το 418 μ.Χ.», and the page heads him «(; - 418)». It gives no year of birth, only that he lived «μεταξύ του 4ου και 5ου αιώνα μ.Χ.» and was elected bishop in 388.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Αγαπητός Επίσκοπος Ωξέρρης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The see, Ωξέρρης, is Auxerre in Gaul, and it is what tells him from the corpus's three other Agapiti — of Synnada, of the Kyiv Caves and the deacon — none of whom is a Gaulish bishop of the fourth and fifth centuries. His wife Martha is named and became a nun; the corpus holds no folder the page identifies with her, so there is no `related` row. The page gives 388 for his election and 418 for his death, and no year of birth. No hymn, no relic.
